canonical_name: No Cybersecurity Requirements in Supply Chain Contracts
description: Requirements to address cybersecurity risks in supply chains are not established and communicated.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Organizations with supplier and third-party relationships Procurement and vendor management teams Supply chain security programs

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for the absence of cybersecurity requirements in supplier contracts and agreements. Check for lack of prioritization of security requirements or missing integration of cybersecurity clauses in third-party agreements.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
